hotels.title: Melbourne Self-Contained Apartments in Southbank with Indoor Heated Pool & Onsite Restaurant
hotels.description: Experience Melbourne's vibrant arts scene from this stylish hotel, perfectly positioned in Southbank's cultural heart. Just a short stroll from the renowned National Gallery of Victoria, the Arts Centre Melbourne and the Royal Botanic Gardens, this hotel is your gateway to the city's best. After a day of exploring, return to the comfort of your spacious self-contained apartment or enjoy a leisurely swim in the indoor heated pool. Savour local flavours at the Mezzi Bar and Kitchen restaurant, or explore the city's famed culinary scene - from bustling coffee shops to Michelin-starred icons - with Southbank's renowned eateries just moments away.

hotels.title: Chic Southbank Melbourne Stay Near NGV with Onsite Cafe
hotels.description: Perfectly positioned, this stylish hotel offers easy access to the city's cultural hotspots including the National Gallery of Victoria and the Arts Centre Melbourne. A short stroll will lead you to the bustling South Melbourne Market, where you can savour fresh produce from hundreds of artisan stalls, all while soaking in the lively atmosphere of this local gem. At base, enjoy a freshly brewed coffee and an array of buffet breakfast delights at the onsite Distrikt Press Cafe. The rest of Melbourne is at your fingertips with Federation Square and Flinders Street Station just 5 minutes away, making it easy to explore everything this dynamic city has to offer.
